title: Latency & Throughput
subtitle: Latency is what one request feels; throughput is what the system sustains
motto: Waiting time explodes long before capacity runs out
keyInsight: As utilization approaches 100%, latency grows without bound while throughput barely improves.

decisions.title: Model one server as a single queue
decisions.description: One arrival rate against one service rate is enough to show why latency curves up near capacity.
decisions.alternatives: A multi-server or bursty-arrival model is closer to reality but hides the one relationship the chapter teaches.
